top_signals.title: US Stocks Drift, Bonds Slip With Focus on Warsh: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stocks drifted ahead of Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s address at Jackson Hole, with traders looking for clarity on his economic outlook and strategy for bringing inflation back to target.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: It’s Probably Time for the Fed to Do More, Says Economist Sahm
top_signals.summary: “There is something shifting in the inflation picture in the US right now,” says Claudia Sahm, chief economist at New Century Advisors. She says on “Bloomberg Surveillance” that it would be “most appropriate” for the Federal Reserve to start raising rates. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Egypt’s LNG Comeback Is Set to Start in Cyprus
top_signals.summary: Egypt’s gas sector is running short of domestic gas just as Cyprus prepares to become a producer. The recently approved Cronos project offshore Cyprus (expected to deliver up to 2.8 million tonnes per year of LNG from 2028) offers a three-way bargain. Cyprus gains an export route it cannot economically build alone; Egypt secures feedstock for infrastructure increasingly constrained by falling domestic production, and Europe gains another non-Russian source. The logic is compelling, but technical, commercial and geopolitical risks could still…

top_signals.title: Baltic Dry Index climbs to 3186 up 79 points
top_signals.summary: Today, Friday, August 28 2026, the Baltic Dry Index climbed 79 points, 3186 points. top_signals.title: Ex-head of resignation assistance firm gets suspended sentence
top_signals.summary: The Tokyo District Court found Shinji Tanimoto and his wife, Shiori, guilty of earning profit from referring customers to lawyers without a license to practice law.
